key_points: Compass Financial Management LLC cuts its position in Edison International (EIX), signaling reduced confidence from a major institutional holder
Earnings miss narrative is emerging, potentially pressuring the stock's fundamental outlook

The combination of position reductions and earnings concerns creates a bearish short-term bias
Monitor upcoming earnings and any further shareholder activity for directional confirmation
